places.name: SonaflozinAvailable
places.description: Sonaflozin units available to start production. Incoming receipts and movement from quarantine into availability are not modeled here.

places.name: FlowbindAvailable
places.description: Flowbind Material units available to start production.

places.name: BatchDue
places.description: External schedule opportunity to start one Sonic Flow batch; the roughly two-week schedule is not generated in this fragment.

places.name: BatchStarted
places.description: One marker for each batch start; completion timing and finished Sonic Flow inventory are outside this fragment.

places.name: SonaflozinQuarantined
places.description: Physically received Sonaflozin held for quality release; separate from production-available. Rejected quantities can move to disposal using an external rejection count, but receipt, inspection, and release to usable stock are not represented.

places.name: RejectedSonaflozinUnits
places.description: Unit count marked for disposal by an external quality decision; the quality inspection/decision is outside this fragment.

places.name: SonaflozinDisposed
places.description: Sonaflozin units removed after quality rejection; this terminal accounting state is not usable for production.

transitions.name: Start Sonic Flow Batch
transitions.description: A scheduled batch starts only if about 699 units each of Sonaflozin and Flowbind Material are available; both inputs are consumed at start. The 699-unit arc weights approximate the reported batch size. The schedule and batch completion are outside this fragment.

transitions.name: Dispose Rejected Sonaflozin
transitions.description: Moves one quarantined Sonaflozin unit marked rejected by an external quality decision into disposal accounting. Lot grouping, inspection, and any replacement order are outside this fragment.
